sources.title: Pacific-i64/TR-HASH-MOE-100M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TR-HASH-MOE-100M is a 99.5M-parameter causal base language model from the Complexity TR-Hash experiments. It combines GQA with a dense shared MLP path and small residual experts selected by a deterministic balanced hash of token identity. The selected route is known without evaluating a learned contextual router.
